from solution import reverse_vowels


def test_issue_example_python():
    """Example: reverse_vowels("Python") == "Python"."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "Python" are ['o'] reversed is ['o'] => "Python"
    assert reverse_vowels("Python") == "Python"


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels of a given string handles empty input."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "" are [] reversed is [] => ""
    assert reverse_vowels("") == ""


def test_issue_no_vowels():
    """Rule: reverse only vowels leaves strings with no vowels unchanged."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "bcd" are [] => unchanged => "bcd"
    assert reverse_vowels("bcd") == "bcd"


def test_issue_single_vowel():
    """Rule: reverse only vowels leaves a single vowel unchanged."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "a" are ['a'] reversed is ['a'] => "a"
    assert reverse_vowels("a") == "a"


def test_issue_single_consonant():
    """Rule: reverse only vowels leaves a single consonant unchanged."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "B" are [] => unchanged => "B"
    assert reverse_vowels("B") == "B"


def test_issue_two_vowels_hello():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels swaps vowel order in place."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "hello" are ['e','o'] reversed ['o','e'] => "holle"
    assert reverse_vowels("hello") == "holle"


def test_issue_all_vowels_lowercase():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels reverses an all-vowel string."""
    # hand-computed: vowels ['a','e','i'] reversed ['i','e','a'] => "iea"
    assert reverse_vowels("aei") == "iea"


def test_issue_all_vowels_uppercase():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels reverses uppercase vowels too."""
    # hand-computed: vowels ['A','E','I','O','U'] reversed => "UOIEA"
    assert reverse_vowels("AEIOU") == "UOIEA"


def test_issue_mixed_case_swap():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels swaps vowels preserving case characters."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "AbE" are ['A','E'] reversed ['E','A'] => "EbA"
    assert reverse_vowels("AbE") == "EbA"


def test_issue_consonants_stay_in_place():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels keeps consonants in same positions."""
    # hand-computed: vowels in "apple" are ['a','e'] reversed ['e','a'] with 'ppl' fixed => "eppla"
    assert reverse_vowels("apple") == "eppla"


def test_contract_returns_str():
    """Rule: reverse only the vowels of a given string returns a string."""
    # hand-checked: output for "hello" must be an instance of str => True
    assert isinstance(reverse_vowels("hello"), str) is True


def test_contract_preserves_length():
    """Rule: reversing only vowels must not change string length."""
    # hand-counted: len("hello world") = 5 + 1 + 5 = 11
    assert len(reverse_vowels("hello world")) == 11
